description: GlassVein router persistent grants for session-control-endpoint. Use with: glassvein-router --state-file grants-session-control.json

notes: announce.route: needed to register this endpoint with router
control.add_prompt: needed to inject prompts into sessions
session.list: needed to enumerate active sessions
session.read: needed to read session state and messages
route.list: needed for read-only route discovery
admin.rules.write: EXPLICITLY DENIED — use Console endpoint or admin.request pattern for rule management
admin.routes.write: EXPLICITLY DENIED — same reason as above
